snes9x.note: The region sets the video standard only. Satellaview and Sufami Turbo BIOS follow the game type, not the region.

snes-region.description: Header at 0x7FB0 (LoROM) or 0xFFB0 (HiROM), plus 0x200 when a copier header is present. Byte +0x29 (0x7FD9 or 0xFFD9) is the region.
